bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:370a064b-fbe3-.title: Copywriter
bumbleinc-bumbleinc:lever:370a064b-fbe3-.description: Bumble’s Creative Studio is at an exciting inflection point. We’re growing rapidly, supporting Bumble Inc.’s portfolio of apps globally and we want this momentum to continue. As part of this expansion, we’re looking to hire a Copywriter to be a part of our small but mighty team, working on global projects and across time zones. In this role within the Creative Studio, you’ll help develop effective and culturally relevant work for our portfolio of brands. You’ll be part of a full-service, in-house, geographically diverse creative team of designers, art directors, copywriters, video editors, and producers who work hand-in-hand with external production and agency partners. The person we’re looking for is equal parts concept and craft. Someone who appreciates a big idea as much as they do a well-placed em-dash. A writer’s writer who knows how to optimize copy per platform and deliver breakthrough ideas rooted in strategy. Your work will span a wide variety of touchpoints for Bumble Inc.—from social and digital to OOH, experiential, TV, audio, and beyond—in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where your creativity and voice will play a crucial role. This role is based in the US, reporting to the Copy Lead.
qualifications: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or have an outstanding portfolio that speaks for itself.
3+ years of copywriting experience, ideally with some of it spent in-house.
You have a clear command of copy best practices and superb writing skills.
You have a keen cultural curiosity and your finger on the pulse of trends, insights, and culture.
You are positive and committed with a ‘can-do’ attitude and a flexible approach to complex briefs.
You have great communication skills, both verbal and written, and are confident presenting and defending your creative decisions to stakeholders.
You’re comfortable working autonomously (owning your copy) and in collaboration with others (discovering a solution together).
You thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects across multiple time zones and meeting tight deadlines without compromising on quality.
You have excellent time management and organisational skills. You take full ownership of your work, down to the smallest detail.
You are highly conceptual, delivering breakthrough creative ideas that are consumer-centric to their core.
You are self-aware and accountable, and you bring the same care and rigour to a social caption as you do to a full campaign.
You are passionate about our brand vision and values.

Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. distro-distro:lever:e26c5e54-1025-48b1-8.description: We are a proud work-from-office company. If you're ready to work on-site in a dynamic, global company, we'd love to hear from you. About Us Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer Solution” headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting www.vensure.com . Position Summary The Risk Operations Supervisor provides hands-on, day-to-day operational leadership for the Risk Operations function, supporting Underwriting, Loss Control, and Workers' Compensation Claims activities. This role is responsible for supervising staff, ensuring consistent execution of established processes, maintaining compliance with regulatory, carrier, and internal requirements, and supporting the effective delivery of risk management services. The Risk Operations Supervisor serves as a key liaison between frontline team members and Risk Operations leadership, ensuring operational efficiency, quality, and accountability. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Provide day-to-day supervision of the Risk Operations team, including Coordinators, Associates, Specialists, and Senior Specialists. Assign, prioritize, and monitor workloads to ensure service levels, turnaround times, and quality standards are met. Process and oversee timekeeping, PTO requests, scheduling, and coverage planning for the team. Deliver regular coaching, feedback, and performance guidance to team members. Serve as the first point of escalation for operational issues, complex cases, and workflow challenges. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support underwriting, loss control, and workers' compensation claims operations by ensuring accurate documentation, data integrity, and timely follow-up. Assist with the coordination and execution of loss control activities and follow-up on recommendations. Participate in workers' compensation claim reviews and operational discussions, escalating concerns as appropriate. Support the administration of PEO workers' compensation programs, renewals, and ongoing carrier requirements. Ensure risk-related operational processes align with organizational policies and legal requirements. Monitor team activities to ensure compliance with safety legislation, regulatory requirements, carrier guidelines, and internal policies. Conduct routine quality reviews and audits of work products to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Identify trends, gaps, or recurring issues and recommend process improvements to Risk Operations leadership. Assist with updating and maintaining standard operating procedures (SOPs) and training documentation. Prepare and contribute to operational reports related to productivity, claims activity, underwriting support, and service performance. Communicate regularly with the Risk Operations Manager regarding workload capacity, escalations, and operational risks. Serve as a liaison with internal departments to resolve inter-departmental issues and support risk management objectives. Support special projects and initiatives as assigned by Risk Operations leadership or senior management. Build, maintain and promote relationships with team members, peers across disciplines, and all other company team members ensuring effective coordination of communications and services affecting clients. Attend webinars and training to stay up to date on best practices related to the company and department. Complete projects and other duties as assigned by supervisor. jobgether-jobgether:lever:552554a1-4038-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Romanian Voice Actor – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in India. This freelance opportunity is designed for an experienced Romanian voice professional interested in helping shape the next generation of AI-powered speech technology. You will contribute authentic, high-quality Romanian voice data used to improve the clarity, naturalness, and expressiveness of AI-generated speech. The work combines professional voice performance with speech evaluation, linguistic feedback, and AI training activities. You will record scripted content while assessing AI outputs for pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional accuracy. Your expertise will help refine voice models and evaluation standards for applications spanning accessibility, education, entertainment, and more. The project offers a flexible remote environment suited to experienced contractors with a professional recording setup. It is an opportunity to apply your voice expertise to emerging AI technologies while directly influencing how machines communicate in Romanian. Record scripted material in Romanian with clear pronunciation, natural delivery, consistent pacing, and appropriate emotional expression. Produce high-quality voice recordings suitable for AI training and speech-model development. Evaluate AI-generated speech for linguistic accuracy, pronunciation, naturalness, tone, pacing, and expressiveness. Identify and annotate errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated outputs and provide clear, actionable feedback. Assess regional and linguistic variations in Romanian to help improve the authenticity and robustness of voice models. Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, annotation practices, and voice-design guidelines. Apply professional voice-acting expertise to distinguish natural human speech from awkward, inaccurate, or unnatural AI-generated responses. Maintain consistent recording quality and follow technical, linguistic, and project-specific guidelines throughout assignments. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in Romanian voice acting, dubbing, narration, or a closely related performance discipline. Native-level or highly proficient Romanian language skills with excellent pronunciation and linguistic accuracy. Strong vocal control, including the ability to adjust tone, pacing, emphasis, emotion, and delivery according to different scripts and contexts. Excellent listening and evaluation skills, with the ability to identify subtle pronunciation, fluency, and naturalness issues. Strong attention to detail and the ability to provide precise, constructive feedback. Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to follow detailed project guidelines. Experience with linguistic annotation, voice coaching, AI training, speech evaluation, or similar work is a plus. jobgether-jobgether:lever:cbd681f2-a999-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Clinical Business Analyst – Clinical Documentation based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a major clinical information transformation focused on improving healthcare delivery through standardized digital systems. You will help shape clinical documentation practices, workflows, templates, and content within a large-scale healthcare environment. Working closely with physicians, nurses, nurse practitioners, and other clinical stakeholders, you will translate operational needs into effective digital solutions. At least 5 years of experience supporting large-scale acute-care digital health transformations or CIS/EHR implementations. Direct experience implementing Clinical Information Systems, Electronic Health Records, or Electronic Medical Records at a comparable scale. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:45cb9ea1-8e9c-4f78.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Operations Manager (Affiliate), щоб разом піднімати планку результату. Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі: На що ти будеш впливати: Що для нас важливо: Буде перевагою: Твої майбутні задачі: — Оцінка, впровадження та вдосконалення процесів; — Організація та підтримка щоденних операційних процесів; — Підвищення ефективності команди шляхом підтримки у втіленні нових проєктів; — Реалізація стратегії щодо автоматизації щоденних задач; — Взаємодія з іншими командами в зоні маркетингу для ефективної фасилітації проєктів. Ідеальний кандидат для нас має: — Системне та аналітичне мислення; — Вміння ефективно працювати з великою кількістю операційних процесів; — Уважність до деталей; — Бажання брати на себе відповідальність, та бути проактивним. Буде перевагою: — Розуміння трекінку, технічних сетапів, трекінг платформ; Що повинен вміти Account Manager: — Читати юніт-економіку офера та перевіряти окупність; — Налаштовувати S2S постбеки та діагностувати їх; — Знаходити причину розбіжностей у статистиці; — Будувати трекінг-лінки з правильними макросами; — Аналізувати воронку та пропонувати покращення/ оптимизації. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. - Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. - Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:8815f772.description: At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. APPLYING TO RENDER We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. ABOUT THE ROLE Render's mission is to eliminate the undifferentiated work that goes into building software products by offering an easy-to-use, powerful cloud platform for developer teams of all sizes. We're looking for a software engineer with a strong identity and security focus to join our Expansion team. You'll help build the authentication, authorization, and access-management primitives that Render's customers depend on including SSO, RBAC, audit logging, scoped credentials and SCIM provisioning. This is not a security operations or compliance role. You'll own changes across Render's platform and think carefully about how to make security features feel built in, not bolted on. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design and ship authentication and authorization systems for users, agents, and services including credential scoping, SSO, SCIM provisioning and fine-grained permission models. - Evolve Render's authorization model toward clear permissions and scopes for applications, environments, projects, and other platform resources. - Own the security experience across the stack, from the interfaces used to manage features through to the APIs, data models and systems behind them. - Build the controls and audit trails customers use to define, enforce and understand how people, services and agents act within their systems. - Design shared auth APIs and primitives, then work closely with Product, Design, Security, and other Render teams to drive adoption. - Operate authentication and authorization systems that customers and other teams depend on, including observability, safe rollouts, incident response, and on-call. triedgeinvestments-triedge-investments:a.title: People Operations Associate
triedgeinvestments-triedge-investments:a.description: People Operations Associate About TriEdge Investments TriEdge Investments is a family office and technology company based in New York. We make concentrated investments in a few companies. We also incubate technology companies to solve the problems our investment team observes in our portfolio companies. In this sense, we've proven it's a true industry problem. We only focus on select healthcare verticals. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes and reduce the complexity of healthcare through better investing and technology. To do this, we find and foster extraordinary people who can think hyper-rationally yet with creativity. Our talent philosophy is that to do something different, you must be different. We enjoy working with people who think so too. What We're Really Looking For We’re looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented People Operations Associate to work alongside our People Analyst and support day-to-day People Operations across the full employee lifecycle. This role will take meaningful ownership of core HR programs and infrastructure-including benefits administration, 401(k) plan operations, PEO management, HR systems, and people reporting-while supporting special projects such as new entity setup, international expansion, and equity issuance. This is an ideal role for someone early in their HR career who wants exposure to sophisticated People Operations in a high-performance, fast-growing environment. Key Responsibilities - Administer the company’s 401(k) plan, including enrollments, contributions, compliance coordination, and vendor communication - Support annual benefits renewals and open enrollment in partnership with the PEO and benefits brokers - Manage day-to-day PEO operations, serving as a key point of contact for employee record changes, benefits, payroll processing, and compliance matters - Support new company/entity setup, including coordination with legal, finance, payroll, and benefits providers - Manage the unemployment claims process, working with external vendors and ensuring timely documentation and responses - Maintain and update the employee handbook, people policies, and internal documentation to ensure ongoing compliance - Support employee equity issuance processes, including onboarding coordination with legal, cap table providers, and internal stakeholders - Own administration of HR systems and tools (HRIS, ATS, payroll/PEO platforms), ensuring data accuracy and process documentation - Partner with the People Analyst on people reporting and analytics, supporting headcount reporting, turnover metrics, and workforce insights - Support international expansion projects, including coordination with external advisors on employment setup, payroll, and benefits in new geographies - Own people-related projects across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, audits, and compliance initiatives Who You Are - Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field - 5 years of relevant experience in HR, People Operations, or related administrative/operations roles (internships or contract experience welcomed) - Exposure to or interest in benefits administration, PEO models, and HR systems - Strong attention to detail with a love for building clean, scalable processes - Self-identifying as a numbers/data person; Excel/Google Sheets proficiency preferred - Tech-forward and quick to learn new tools (experience with HRIS, ATS, PEO platforms, or Notion/Slack a plus) - High integrity with the ability to handle sensitive employee information with discretion and professionalism - Proactive, dependable, and excited to grow within a small, high-impact People team Location TriEdge is an in-person team with offices in Hudson Yards, New York. This role is expected to be in office Monday - Thursday, working remotely on Fridays. Pay transparency The annual base salary range for this position is $110,000 – $130,000, which does not include discretionary bonus

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:6739fc27-b7d.description: About the Role We are looking for detail-oriented Quality Control (QC) Specialist to support an AI data annotation project. In this role, you will review the work submitted by Trainers — pre-seeded questions paired with images and their corresponding "golden" answers — to confirm accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project guidelines. This is a task-based, remote-friendly opportunity ideal for individuals who are highly meticulous, observant, and skilled at spotting errors or inconsistencies that others may miss. What You'll Do Review completed tasks submitted by Trainers, including the original question, the image, and the golden answer provided
